d:
Hello everyone!!
I'm DarkSeeker, this is my first comic. It's one of three short prequels leading up to the main comix called "Hell-bound: The Broken Ward". This mini-comic is quite simple but it was important for me as it helped me get acquainted with ComicLife. Future projects will contain more adult-themes content, such as dark fantasy, corruption and 18+ action.
Since we're here, let me share a few things about me:
* I do this as a hobby. I'm not a professional artist, but I'm passionate about my projects.
* I've always been more of a writer than a visual artist. That's why I try to give my stories some depth and mainly use OCs (with a few exceptions).
* English isn't my first language, so please be patient.
* One important heads-up: I don’t like stories where the “good” guys win, so don’t expect a secondary character swooping in at the last moment to save the day, hehe.
DarkSeeker Comix BLOG: https://darkseekercomix.blogspot.com/
or watch me in deviantArt: https://www.deviantart.com/devdarkseeker
